description:
Local-first API testing tool to inspect, test and mock APIs.

API Spector is a free, open-source, local-first API testing tool. Send requests, mock APIs, run contract tests, and monitor your APIs — plus a hosted, Pact-compatible contract broker and deploy gate that stop breaking changes. Your data stays in the EU.
What's Changed
- fix: atomicWrite is now idempotent by @testsmith-io in https://github.com/testsmith-io/api-spector/pull/112
Full Changelog: https://github.com/testsmith-io/api-spector/compare/0.9.10...0.9.11
